## Requirements: Experience-aware Session and Project operation surfaces

### Problem / current verified baseline (2026-11-09)
The shared `web/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx` defaults to `sm:max-w-sm` (384 CSS px). `AttachDialog` inherits this cap, while `CreateSessionDialog` overrides to `sm:max-w-md` (448px), including Project → Create Session (`ProjectDialogs` reuses the same dialog). Project Create/Settings are `sm:max-w-lg` (512px). Real Agent/path/address content becomes clipped, visually dense or nested-scroll dependent. This is a **layout/presentation** decision, not a request to change Session/Project/attach protocols.

Existing Project behavior #3025 is complete and closed. This requirement introduces a **different, cross-Experience presentation contract** across existing flows; do not reopen #3025 merely to adjust its already-accepted domain behavior. Related #3021, #3082, #2875 and #3075 retain their separate owners.

### Decision — two experience presentations, one business owner
**Web:** responsive centered dialogs that use available desktop width without becoming full-window forms. Initial design targets (not hard width constants): Attach 720px, Create Session (with or without Project) 640px, Project Create/Settings 720px; clamp to viewport minus safe margins, available height and content. Maintain predictable header/footers and a single scroll owner for overflow.

- Attach: keep Auto/P2P/Relay comparison usable side by side on wide surfaces; give candidate addresses their own readable rows, honest reachable/latency state, explicit complete value view/copy and re-test. Long URLs are not silently invisible behind truncation.
- Create Session: preserve the Existing Agent+directory semantics from #3025; render Agent and path as legible distinct lines instead of concatenated single-line Select text. Group Session name, location and ENV choices with progressive disclosure. Avoid a 160px nested ENV scroller when space is available.
- Project Create/Settings: location editor provides enough width for Agent and Directory, responsive stacking when the content is constrained. No horizontal page/form scrolling.

**App (experience=app):** do NOT shrink Web dialogs into centered narrow cards.

- Default **Attach intent** opens a compact bottom sheet: Session identity, current Auto mode summary, one primary Attach action, entry to Connection settings. Keep Terminal mounted underneath; closing/Back does not attach or change another Session. Explicit **Attach settings / configure intent** opens the full configuration view directly, with Save/Cancel semantics (never accidentally attach).
- Full Attach configuration is an App-owned full-height operation page: single header/back, vertical mode radio rows, legible addresses/status/latency, re-test and scrollable middle, safe-area-aware persistent footer. Back from settings initiated by the quick sheet returns to the sheet with draft/selection preserved; cancelling an explicit configure intent returns to the original Sessions layer.
- App **Create Session**, including Project → New Session, is a full-height operation page: single Back in header, Session Name field, a compact **Existing Location** choice (Agent / path / status on distinct lines), ENV summary that pushes a selection list, one anchored Create Session CTA. No desktop two/three-column controls. Back from child choice returns to the draft; cancellation returns to the originating Project detail / Sessions context. Valid submission selects/opens the created Session, without remounting an existing Terminal while editing.
- App Project Create/Settings uses the same page/depth principles; locations are stacked vertically with touch-sized actions, not compressed `flex` rows.
- App portrait and landscape respect Nession's keyboard/visualViewport and safe-area fixture contracts; avoid multiple independent vertically scrollable form regions and accidental horizontal scrolling. The system must preserve validation/errors, disabled/offline state, draft on child navigation and restore focus/context on dismissal.

**Shared semantics:** keep `useCreateSessionForm` and the canonical Attach selection/probing/confirmation owner. Only the **presentation/experience composition** varies; `experience=web|app` is the deciding experience, not solely `@media`. Narrow explicitly forced Web remains a responsive Web dialog; wide explicitly forced App remains the App navigation hierarchy. The App has one host-owned Back per depth, as required by `docs/design/interaction/app.md`. Do not introduce a second attach implementation, backend endpoint, Project domain type, standalone mobile application or new transport state.

### User journeys to validate
1. Web Session list → Attach → Auto/P2P/Relay and long address → confirm/cancel; Web Project detail → Create Session → Agent/location/ENV → create, with no page-level horizontal scroll.
2. App Sessions → Session menu → Attach → bottom sheet → advanced settings → Back → Attach; App Session menu → Attach settings → edit → Save → return without attaching.
3. App Sessions → Project → standalone detail → New Session → pick Existing Location → ENV list → Back with draft intact → Create → selected Terminal. Also empty/error/offline, landscape and keyboard scenarios.
4. App Project create/settings location rows can be read and edited, including a long directory on a 375px device.

### Verification design
- **SCN-02 / browser** for SC-01…SC-05: source-aligned Chromium+Playwright `type: browser` Cases, canonical `design/contracts/viewports.json` Web 1280/1440/1920 and App 375/390/430/844×390, plus forced `?experience=web|app`; inspect computed dimensions/scrollWidth, focus, Back/ESC/outside dismissal, touch-sized controls, errors and keyboard/safe-area app-owned fixtures. Runner: approved scoped browser CI Case at exact PR SHA.
- **SCN-08 / artifact** for SC-06: exact orphan `prototype` source SHA, mock file + gallery/README links, published Pages manifest/HTML independently checked where claimed. Only design artifact proof; no Session backend or production Acceptance result can be derived from a mock.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 Web Attach and Create Session surfaces use responsive content-capable layouts (not inherited 384/448px desktop caps), expose complete long path/address values, and have no unintended horizontal scrolling at the tested widths.
- [x] SC-02 Web Project Create/Settings existing locations remain editable/readable and their controls reflow within available width; overflow does not require horizontal page/form scroll.
- [x] SC-03 App Attach quick sheet, configuration depth and explicit configure intent implement the documented distinct Attach vs Save action/back/dismiss semantics without disturbing the active Terminal/selected Session before confirm.
- [x] SC-04 App Project and non-Project Create Session flows show a full-height single-header operation page with child Location/ENV selection, draft preservation, persistent safe-area CTA, validated disabled/error states, and correct return to originating context/created Session.
- [x] SC-05 App Project Create/Settings and the cross-experience forced-mode/narrow/landscape transitions remain touch-accessible, correctly ordered, and free of accidental horizontal overflow or multiple competing Back owners.
- [x] SC-06 A clickable, public-safe prototype documents and exercises the Web/App journeys with a version-pinned orphan source and a verified preview status (record any publication lag as Pending, never as Pass).
- [ ] SC-07 Web Project → New Session Existing Location: the Select Trigger grows to fully contain selected Agent, wrapped Directory and status; the opened list's options shrink/wrap within its available width rather than clipping or widening the form. At 1440/1180/1024 and narrow forced-Web viewports, Chromium geometry asserts all text boxes remain inside their trigger/option bounds, no x-axis overflow, usable pointer/keyboard selection, and one scroll owner for constrained viewport heights.
- [ ] SC-08 The existing `session-operation-surfaces-3089` prototype demonstrates **selected Location trigger → anchored dropdown (Agent/path only) → choose location → closed selected state**, plus source-aligned Web/App EnvFileMultiSelect (search, 16px check, source badges, var count, 224px Web scroll list, selected count) and New Project Agent/Directory height/width behavior under normal/long-path/offline fixtures; its HTML, README and gallery are checked at an immutable `prototype` commit and independently verified public Pages revision.

### Post-acceptance UI geometry regression (2026-11-09; issue reopened)

**Description / observation:** Project → New Session renders the selected Agent, a potentially wrapped directory path, and Agent online/offline status inside `ProjectLocationDetails`, but `SelectTrigger` defaults to `data-[size=default]:h-8`. The feature's `h-auto min-h-10` cannot reliably override that more-specific fixed-height selector. In the same shared Select owner, `SelectItemText` uses `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap` while the popup limits width to `--anchor-width` and hides horizontal overflow. The mock previously used stacked choice cards and therefore did not exercise the actual Select boundary.

**Reproduction:** Web Project details → New Session → Existing Location. Use a multi-segment directory and observe selected three-line content vs control border; open options and inspect path clipping at reduced viewport widths. This regression is source-confirmed; an exact browser screenshot/measurement is still needed for runtime proof.

**Root Cause:** A single-line height/width contract in the generic Select primitive is used for a multi-line location record. This is distinct from the dialog-width/layout issue already resolved by #3089.

**Impact:** Control content may extend beyond the bordered Trigger; dropdown choices may clip long paths and become hard to inspect/select.

**Fix Direction:** Add an explicit content-sized/multi-line Select variant at the generic owner; set `min-w-0`, `flex-shrink`, wrapping on the option and inner texts without globally changing single-line Select usage. Keep the popup aligned to the anchor, avoid creating horizontal form scroll, and make the selected-state height content-driven. Validate in Chromium+Playwright with normal, long path, offline and empty scenarios. Prototype-only improvements do **not** close the production UI regression.

**Location:** `web/src/components/ui/select.tsx`, `web/src/product/session/components/CreateSessionDialog.tsx`, `web/src/product/session/components/CreateSessionParts.tsx`, browser Case `e2e/tests/browser/project-session-create.spec.ts`.

SC-08 → SCN-08 (existing prototype publication/manifest readback lane, case; mock only). **Prototype decision: Required** for this material correction to the accepted UX because the original mock did not include a Select-style dropdown. Existing SC-01…06 receipts remain historical and untouched. No changes to the already-valid E2E ID selection or report are implied.

### Visual fidelity regression follow-up (2026-11-09, owner complaint)

**User feedback:** "location 的输入框高度和宽度不对；env 那里样式都错了". A real Chromium screenshot confirmed that the mock's generic `.dialog-form .field input` CSS had overridden each Env checkbox with full width and 42px height. The previous geometry Task #42635141729 measured only form edges; it did **not** verify child control size and did not justify claiming component-level fidelity.

**Corrected prototype (source-aligned, not production code):** `prototype/session-operation-surfaces-3089/`
- Web Location selected trigger shows Agent + path + online/offline caption, shrinks/grows to text (68px on normal path; 83px on long path) and stays at 594px available form width; popup options show only Agent + path (no repeated status), overlay rather than push the form, match the trigger width, and wrap paths without horizontal overflow.
- Web Env is the existing `EnvFileMultiSelect` anatomy: 32px search, 224px scrollable list, 16x16 check, icon, source badges, variable count, selected count, functional query and selection. No standalone raw checkbox rows. App has a separate full-depth searchable Env list, without nested fixed-height scroll; form order follows actual `AppCreateSessionSurface` (Session Name first).
- Web New Project Agent Select / Directory are 42px high **both when the Directory is one line**; the textarea grows to 76px when a test path wraps. This is an intentional Web prototype candidate; production's two-row textarea requires a separate implementation decision.

**Source and browser diagnostic evidence:** [latest revised prototype source](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/f3c0e8dd0f85f93c6dd3174ba6134c3af138c228/session-operation-surfaces-3089). [Task #42639910237](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/42639910237) 6/6 Web 1440/1180/1024 + App 390/375/landscape: Web Location 594x68, options 50px each without status, Env search 32, check 16x16, list 224, no horizontal overflow, search/filter/selection and App back persistence. [Task #42640529645](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/42640529645) 3/3 Web long-path: control 594x83; options wrap and fit in 594px with no x-overflow. [Task #42640999912](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/42640999912) 3/3 Web Project Location normal vs long: Agent/Directory baseline 42/42, grows Directory to 76px. Tests captured actual Chromium screenshots of both Web/App and open/closed dropdown, not just geometry data. All Task checks are **non-authoritative diagnostic prototype evidence** and are not production Acceptance Pass. SC-07/SC-08 remain Pending until the approved source/Pages acceptance paths verify the actual product/public revision. Do not replace historical accepted SC-01…06 receipts.
